svg.text: L43 stop-dose-resurrection: NO kill dose; structure inverts, entrainment protects
DNg88 release on the entrained cord (l42 substrate, anchors bit-identical). late ratio = rhythm2 peak/median, last 5 s of stop; S during = rolling antagonist-S median in-window
A. dose grid (rows: duration; cols: release amp)
ent: no release, drive stays on 0.7 Hz (reference)
entx: DNg88 -12 x 30 s + drive ON through the release
Verdict: no cell parks (late ratio ≥ 63 everywhere, even 30 s at −12 fully un-pinned);
deep doses INVERT structure (S → −0.74); drive-through attenuates; repair ≤ 2.8 s after drive resumes
